selected.description: Malaysian singer-songwriter known for her soulful voice and blend of pop, R&B, and folk music.

properties.description: Established in 1856, the company is a quintessential British luxury fashion house celebrated for its invention of the trench coat and its signature check pattern. It offers a wide range of luxury clothing, accessories, and beauty products that balance tradition with modern design. With a focus on global reach and high-end retail, it remains a cornerstone of the international luxury market. The brand successfully marries its rich archival heritage with contemporary fashion-forward collections.
properties.short_description: Burberry is a British luxury fashion house known for its clothing, bags, accessories, and fragrances.

properties.description: A dominant global retail force that revolutionized the industry with its high-speed supply chain and trend-responsive business model. Originating in Spain in 1975 under the Inditex parent company, it provides a vast array of clothing, accessories, and footwear for men, women, and children. The brand is known for its ability to bring runway-inspired trends to the mass market with remarkable efficiency. Its global reach and constant store refreshes make it a staple for fashion-conscious shoppers across all major metropolitan markets.
properties.short_description: Zara is a global fast fashion retailer offering trendy clothing, shoes, and accessories for women, men, and kids, along with home decor through Zara Home.

properties.description: Established in 1837, this house is a legendary American jeweler that has defined the global standard for engagement rings and luxury accessories. Renowned for its iconic blue packaging, the brand combines time-honored craftsmanship with visionary design from artists like Elsa Peretti and Jean Schlumberger. It operates as a multinational retailer, offering a curated selection of fine jewelry, sterling silver, and watches to a sophisticated clientele worldwide. As part of a larger luxury conglomerate, it remains a premier authority in the jewelry industry, emphasizing authenticity, lifetime warranties, and exceptional gemstone quality.
properties.short_description: Tiffany & Co. is a luxury jewelry brand renowned for its fine craftsmanship and timeless designs since 1837.

properties.description: Founded in 1910, this iconic French fashion house revolutionized the industry with its focus on modern, elegant silhouettes for women. Known globally for its exquisite haute couture, high-end fragrances, and timeless accessories, it continues to define the pinnacle of luxury. The brand maintains a powerful cultural presence through its commitment to artisanal craftsmanship and heritage design. It serves a discerning global audience, balancing traditional craftsmanship with contemporary sophistication.
properties.short_description: Chanel is a luxury fashion brand known for fashion, accessories, fragrance, skincare, makeup, fine jewellery, and watches.

properties.description: A preeminent global fashion house founded in New York City in 1941, renowned for its enduring legacy in high-quality leatherware and lifestyle accessories. The brand balances its rich archival heritage with a modern design vision that prioritizes authentic self-expression and inclusive storytelling. Its extensive product range spans handbags, ready-to-wear clothing, footwear, and leather goods, appealing to a broad demographic of style-conscious individuals. By focusing on accessible luxury and craftsmanship, the entity maintains a significant presence in the global fashion market while continuously evolving its aesthetic to resonate with contemporary audiences.
properties.short_description: COACH is a luxury fashion brand known for handbags, wallets, clothing, menswear, shoes, and accessories.
